title.p: Chapter 1418: He tu is here, run! (1)

section.p: “Immortals…I still remember Tiangu’s kill order against me.”

Su Yu laughed and looked around. The seventh-stage Mountainsea was no weakling, especially since he had a drop of Invincible blood essence on him. If he was a descendant of Tiangu, he would be even stronger than regular Mountainseas as the bloodline of Tiangu would most certainly be a powerful one.

Then again, someone like this still wouldn’t be a difficult kill for Su Yu. He only needed to be careful and prevent the activation of the Invincible blood essence. While he was deep in thought, the immortals started speaking again.

“Dao Cheng was in too much of a hurry to leave. I didn’t even get the chance to tell him that Bai Feng and the others are on the third level. Anyone related to Su Yu must die. I wonder if they will wait for us on the third level. We need to work together and kill them all.”
“Dao Cheng?”
Su Yu blanked out slightly. Fled? What?

Why did it feel like Dao Cheng was always so lucky? Su Yu had long wanted to kill Dao Cheng, but he had never found a chance to do so despite their many encounters. Or to be precise, when an opportunity came, something would happen to keep him busy. For example, he was kept busy by Zhan Wushuang during his last encounter with Dao Cheng.
At the time, he had instinctively targeted Zhan Wushuang to force the divines to go after him. As a result, Dao Cheng was spared from his attention.

Was Dao Cheng here earlier? Su Yu frowned. Dao Cheng…that fellow had survived him one too many times. No matter what, he had to kill Dao Cheng this time. A strong enemy was not scary. A resilient enemy was much scarier.
Since fate had allowed Dao Cheng to survive him repeatedly, Dao Cheng could very well grow into a dangerous opponent of him in the future. He had to deal with this.
“Third level…sure. I’ll sweep through all the levels and kill you.”
Dao Cheng must die. That was Su Yu’s decision. Since Dao Cheng had fled before his arrival, it was clear Dao Cheng had sensed the coming danger. That was a very sharp man.
“For now, I’ll settle for killing these people.”
Then, Su Yu tossed his book into the sky. Instantly, the book vanished into the void. It wasn’t too hard to kill these people.

He could simply shout Tai Shan’s name again. That would create a massive disturbance and distract them all. The chaos would give him the chance to kill the Mountainsea before the others could even react.
“Tai Shan!”
“Kill! I’ll kill you!”
Once again, Old Zhou’s voice rang out in Su Yu’s head. This time, he sounded even more furious than before. Boundless resentment could be heard in his voice.
The flames around the dragonblood fruit tree started raging, instantly injuring the immortals in the area. The expression of their leader sank as he roared, “Retreat–”

Right as that word left his mouth, his expression changed. He could sense the approach of an intense crisis. But when he looked around, he saw nothing. Abruptly, someone walked out of the void. Without saying anything, the silhouette clawed at his heart.
“You…”

Gu Zhu was alarmed. Just as he was about to flee, a sharp pain assaulted his head. A massive hammer had struck his sea of willpower, throwing him into a daze. With a spurt, the drop of blood essence was plucked out by Su Yu.
Hissing sounds rang out as the Invincible blood essence struggled and roared.

The moment Su Yu caught the drop of blood essence, his entire arm was set aflame. This drop of blood essence had been tamed by Gu Zhu’s elder. Or perhaps it was simply the blood essence of his elder. Thus, it would remain docile in Gu Zhu’s hands.

But Su Yu was an outsider. Thus, the blood essence reacted instinctively the moment it made contact with Su Yu. Even with Su Yu’s powerful flesh, the flesh on his arm was instantly burned into nothingness.

Then, the flame started burning his bones. Resisting the intense pain, Su Yu gnashed his teeth and roared. At that, a book dropped down from the sky and released dozens of Sunmoon beasts. Instantly, all the other immortals were swallowed. Then, the beasts charged toward the drop of blood essence.
At that point, a faintly discernible silhouette was starting to form in the drop of blood essence. The silhouette was on the verge of walking out of the drop of blood.
“Impudent!”
A furious roar resounded from the blood essence. That single roar was enough to scare the charging beasts, causing them to hesitate.
That single hesitation caused Su Yu’s face to turn unsightly as he roared furiously, “Bastard!”
If they were so cowardly, why should he keep them around? How dare they disobey him just because of a projection? How could they show fear toward a mere projection?
Damn it!

In his fury, the culture and radiance characters manifested. With a rumble, the hesitating beasts were blasted apart before more beasts appeared to replace them. This time, they showed no fear. Nearly a hundred Sunmoon beasts roared and charged the drop of blood essence, suppressing it.
At this point, Gu Zhu was still alive. He stared at Su Yu in disbelief and roared, “Su—”
With one swing of his blade, Su Yu cut Gu Zhu’s head off before dragging Gu Zu into his book.

Done with that, Su Yu returned his focus to dealing with the drop of blood essence. A large amount of Emperor’s Saliva appeared and covered his entire body. In such a manner, he started fighting a battle of endurance against the blood essence.
He refused to believe in defeat. Yes, he couldn’t defeat an Invincible. But was he supposed to lose to a mere drop of blood essence? Was this a joke? He was determined to win.
When Su Yu punched the drop of blood essence, the same voice rang out again, “Impudent!”
Clearly, the master of this blood essence was still alive.

Su Yu suspected that this expert was the elder of the dead Mountainsea immortal. He was unsure if it was Tiangu, but he doubted that. This expert was not giving off the stifling sensation Tiangu would emanate.
“Impudent your ancestors!”
With a furious roar, Su Yu started raining punches on the drop of blood essence.
As numerous Sunmoon beasts worked together to suppress the drop of blood essence, a middle-aged man appeared above the drop of blood essence. He roared furiously, “Impudent—”
What? Was this the only word this guy knew? Su Yu grew even angrier. Was this guy looking down on him?
“Bite him to death!”
The Sunmoons did as told.

As for Su Yu, he resumed his attacks, using his punches, weapons, five elements, and everything else he knew. He couldn’t believe he was fighting a drop of blood. More importantly, he could very well lose without the assistance of his Mark of Civilization.
Wouldn’t that be embarrassing? No, that would be a terrifying thought to entertain. That signified that the master of this drop of blood essence was most definitely not a weakling.
At the same time.
Immortal Realm.

An immortal had suddenly soared into the sky from his cultivation room. He looked sharply in a certain direction. Then, he tore space apart to create a spatial tunnel before stepping into it. Instantly, he reached the realm entrance.
“Ancestor.”
Tiangu was still there. Seeing Tiangu, the immortal’s expression changed slightly as he said, “Gu Zhu seems to be dead.”
Tiangu said nothing. He merely nodded, acknowledging the news.
So be it.

He did not have many first-generation descendants. A majority of them had died of old age. Some had been killed during the past eras. This middle-aged immortal was a fifth-generation descendant of his.

As for Gu Zhu, he was a seventh-generation descendant. Tiangu had many seventh-generation descendants around. He had been alive for too long. The deaths of a few descendants no longer mattered to him.
But suddenly, his calm broke as he looked at the middle-aged immortal and scolded coldly, “Impudent! Did you give him your blood essence?”
This seemed quite suspicious. What was the big deal of losing a descendant? Was this such a big deal that it needed to be reported to him?
When he focused inward, he noted that his life force had withered slightly. Instantly, he raged, “You bastard!”
“Ancestor, I—”

Tiangu said, “Even if you wish to seize the nine-leaf skylotus, you shouldn’t have handed your blood essence to a descendant. Even going personally is better than this. You’re not dead. If your blood essence falls into the hands of an enemy…you will be in great trouble.”

In the Myriad Realms, it was common sense that one shouldn’t leak one’s blood essence if one was still alive. Something like blood essence was too important. There were too many ways for one to exploit the blood essence to target the master of the blood essence.

Not even a Skysoar would dare to easily leak their blood essence. Why did this Invincible do something so stupid? Was he brainless? It did not matter how much he loved his descendant. Once given, there would be no guarantee that the blood essence would not fall into the hands of an enemy.
Fool!
The middle-aged immortal paled slightly. With his head lowered, he said, “Ancestor…I-I merely wished to let him—”

“You fool!” Tiangu said, “Stay in seclusion for a period of time lest anyone notice anything. Perhaps your blood essence had burned itself off. When the mansion shuts again, try to sense your blood essence. If it’s still around…I’ll try to get it back.”

There was no denying that this descendant was quite strong. Unfortunately, he seemed too confident in himself. Why was he so sure that nobody would dare to kill his descendant? This could get extremely troublesome.
It wouldn’t be that bad for the blood essence to fall into the hands of a regular person. But in the hands of Invincibles capable of doing something with it…
No, it was stupid to make such an assumption. Anyone capable of killing someone with a drop of Invincible blood essence wouldn’t be a regular person.
Tiangu was furious. But soon, he calmed down and said, “Can you still sense the blood essence now?”

The middle-aged immortal answered, “No. I lost contact with it after it entered the mansion. Just now, something triggered my seal on the blood essence. I wanted to check if Gu Zhu’s tunnel has collapsed.”

Tiangu shut his eyes. At the same time, an indistinct wave of willpower emerged in the Sea of Stars. He saw that Gu Zhu’s tunnel had collapsed. That was not all. The tunnels of many immortals had collapsed.
Tiangu had the answer. He looked at the middle-aged immortal and coldly said, “Dead.”
The middle-aged immortal’s expression turned unsightly. He could only hope that his blood essence had been destroyed. If it had been snatched instead…things could get very troublesome.
Outside the Luminous Domain Mansion.

Everyone sank into silence. The tunnels of more than ten immortals had collapsed at the same time. Of course, none of them was a particularly important individual. Among them, Gu Zhu was the most well-known one. After all, he was an ancient immortal and a descendant of Tiangu. However, most people did not know more than that.

The death of a mere Gu Zhu would not be that big of a deal unless it involved the blood essence of an Invincible. However, Dao King smiled when he saw the collapsing tunnel. Inwardly, he snorted with satisfaction. He recalled that Gu Zhu had the blood essence of a certain someone.
This wasn’t a bad thing. Seeing someone else faced with a disaster was better than facing a disaster himself.
